## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Verification

List checks run and their results. For app changes, include macOS / Xcode versions and any manual scenarios that remain.

- [ ] Regression coverage added or updated for changed behavior, or a reason it is unnecessary.
- [ ] Relevant local checks pass; required CI checks pass before merging.
- [ ] `project.yml` and the regenerated Xcode project agree, if either changed.
- [ ] Documentation and translations updated where the user-facing behavior changed.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility, saved-preference changes, or release implications when relevant. Remove this section if there are none.
